title: Bag Of Bricks -Black 01
descriptionHtml:
Black — colour 01

Black is the hardest-working brick in any mosaic. It draws outlines, deepens shadows, and gives hair and eyes the definition that makes a portrait readable from across the room. It's the colour most builders run short of first.

Works well with: Dark Grey 31, Grey 39, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Black bricks (colour 01) for your Memobrick mosaic. The workhorse shade for outlines, shadows and hair detail. Resealable bag, precision-moulded fit.
